svg.text: BED v8 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Assemble Back and full-height Sides, then Bottom, Top and niche shelves.
2. Fit shelf cable passages and aluminium LED profile under the lit-niche shelf.
3. Keep door-only panel edges plain; retain the approved front setback for fingers.
4. Fit the tall door after wall anchoring. Leave the left upper driver compartment
